## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: tests/drift_injection/inject-and-heal.sh against live DIG with --mode={orphan,mislabel,missing-prop} heals within 1 pass (sc-9) [CI-PROXY ONLY — see notes]
- dd-2: invalid --mode=<unknown> → reconcile.py exits non-zero BEFORE any fetcher call, error names allowed mode set (sc-1, sc-9)
- dd-3: concurrent reconcile.py invocations → second observes .reconciler-pass-lock on tickets branch and exits non-zero without fetching (sc-9)
- dd-4: removing .reconciler-phase-gate is required to advance from bootstrap-strict to bootstrap-throttle (sc-9)

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] main(['--mode=not-a-mode']) exits non-zero; stderr names allowed Mode set; fetcher sentinel NEVER invoked
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py::test_unknown_mode_exits_before_fetcher
- [ ] main(['--mode=dry-run']) exits non-zero when .reconciler-pass-lock present; fetcher sentinel NEVER invoked
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py::test_pass_lock_blocks_before_fetcher
- [ ] main(['--mode=bootstrap-throttle']) exits non-zero when .reconciler-phase-gate present; proceeds past gate after file removal
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py::test_phase_gate_requires_removal_to_advance
- [ ] Pass-lock released in finally on both success and exception paths
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py::test_lock_released_on_exception
- [ ] reconcile.py module-import does NOT load fetcher (lazy import topology preserved/established)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_main.py::test_import_does_not_load_fetcher
- [ ] Existing reconcile_once regressions pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_once.py
- [ ] inject-and-heal.sh continues to invoke reconcile via 'python3 -m dso_reconciler --repo-root ${REPO_ROOT}' (no --mode= flag injected — drift modes are shell case args, NOT rollout modes)
  Verify: grep -E 'python3 -m dso_reconciler' tests/drift_injection/inject-and-heal.sh

## Implementation Notes

### Required execution order (any reorder breaks dd-2/dd-3/dd-4)
```python
def main(argv=None) -> int:
    import argparse
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--mode', required=True)  # do not use choices=[...] — we want our own enum error format
    p.add_argument('--repo-root', type=Path)
    args = p.parse_args(argv)

    # Step 1: Mode validation (dd-2) — BEFORE any fetcher reference
    from .mode import Mode
    try:
        target_mode = Mode.from_str(args.mode)
    except ValueError as e:
        print(str(e), file=sys.stderr); return 2

    # Step 2: pass-lock check (dd-3)
    from ._advisory_lock import check_pass_lock, acquire_pass_lock, release_pass_lock, check_phase_gate
    if check_pass_lock(args.repo_root):
        print('reconcile: .reconciler-pass-lock present on tickets branch — another pass in flight', file=sys.stderr); return 3

    # Step 3: phase-gate check (dd-4)
    if check_phase_gate(target_mode, args.repo_root):
        print(f'reconcile: .reconciler-phase-gate blocks advancement to {target_mode.value}; remove the file from tickets to advance', file=sys.stderr); return 4

    # Step 4: acquire lock + run pass
    pass_id = generate_pass_id()
    acquire_pass_lock(pass_id, args.repo_root)
    try:
        return reconcile_once(pass_id, args.repo_root).get('exit_code', 0)
    finally:
        release_pass_lock(args.repo_root)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

### Fetcher import topology (plan-review F4)
Verified plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/reconcile.py:9-15 has NO top-level fetcher import (uses _load() lazy pattern at line 18). dd-2's RED test asserts `import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.reconcile` does NOT trigger fetcher loading — adds a regression guard.

### dd-1 CI-proxy scope (plan-review F5 + F9)
Verified inject-and-heal.sh:63,96,139 invokes `python3 -m dso_reconciler --repo-root ${REPO_ROOT}` (NO --mode flag — drift modes are shell case args). dd-1's '--mode=orphan|mislabel|missing-prop' refers to inject-and-heal.sh's OWN --mode arg (shell-script parameter), NOT to reconcile.py's --mode flag (rollout-safety enum). dd-1 is operator-driven smoke against live DIG; the CI proxy here is the static grep above. Full validation post-merge.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
